seoTitle: How to Recover a Deleted User in Google Workspace
metaDescription: Learn how Google Workspace admins can recover a deleted user account and its data, and how long you have to act before it's gone for good.
intro: Accidentally deleting a user account can feel like a crisis, especially if it happened before you had a chance to back up their data. This guide walks through how Google Workspace admins can recover a deleted account and restore access.

steps.heading: Act quickly after deletion
steps.body: Google Workspace only allows recovery of a deleted user within a limited window, so the sooner you start the process the better your chances of getting everything back.

steps.heading: Open the Admin Console's deleted users list
steps.body: Super admins can find recently deleted accounts in a dedicated section of the Admin Console rather than the regular Users list.

steps.heading: Restore the account
steps.body: Select the deleted user and choose the restore option, which brings back the account along with associated data where still available.

steps.heading: Verify data and access
steps.body: After restoring, check that Gmail, Drive, and Calendar data are intact and that the user can log back in normally.

steps.heading: Update passwords and permissions
steps.body: As a security step, reset the recovered account's password and review its group memberships and permissions before handing it back to the user.

faq.question: How long do I have to recover a deleted Google Workspace user?
faq.answer: Google Workspace generally gives admins about 20 days after deletion to restore an account, though this window can vary by plan.

faq.question: Will all the user's emails and files come back after recovery?
faq.answer: In most cases yes, as long as recovery happens within the allowed window, though very old or already-purged data may not be recoverable.

faq.question: Can a regular user recover their own deleted account?
faq.answer: No, account recovery for deleted users has to be initiated by a super admin through the Admin Console.

faq.question: What happens if I don't recover the account in time?
faq.answer: Once the recovery window closes, the account and its data are permanently removed and cannot be restored.
